# Vendored test dependency

`googletest-v1.14.0.tar.gz` is the source archive for the official GoogleTest
`v1.14.0` tag (`f8d7d77c06936315286eb55f8de22cd23c188571`). It was downloaded from:

`https://github.com/google/googletest/archive/refs/tags/v1.14.0.tar.gz`

Its SHA-256 is:

`8ad598c73ad796e0d8280b082cebd82a630d73e73cd3c70057938a6501bba5d7`

The archive includes GoogleTest's upstream `LICENSE` file; an exact extracted
copy is retained beside it as `googletest-LICENSE`. CodeSkeptic keeps these
bytes in source authority so test and sanitizer configuration can remain
networkless and reproducible.
